tasks.title: The Card returns 0.875 a unit over 22 groups
tasks.brief:
Settled Card groups since 2026-10-29: 7 of 22 landed (32%) against 7.7 expected (35% quoted), z -0.3; return at the published price 0.875 a unit. The Card's only purpose is a return above 1. Find which class of leg or group loses (sport, price band, the opposition's price band, the gap between model and market, the day of the week) on the pool archive and the football-data replay, and replay a rule that leaves it out. Pre-registered variants are in tools/card_replay.py; add yours there before reading its result.

Use the live record only to locate the gap: never fit on record.json (Rule 1). Test any fix on history, paired and bootstrapped, fitted on the last completed season and confirmed on the current one (Rule 3 gates: 250+ check games, p(worse) at most 0.30, gain at least 0.0005 log loss). If it passes, ship the code change with its evidence. If it does not, ship a dated claude/ note with the numbers so nobody repeats it. Check claude/ and RELEASES.md first: if this exact idea was already rejected, test a different one.
